P1.metric: best model's best-arm strict voice position

P2.metric: k8 - k0 strict position, best k8 model

P3.metric: humanizer: detector change and voice change vs its source draft

P4.metric: strict position, own voice vector minus norm-matched random (mean of 3 seeds), Qwen3-8B layer 24 strength 0.4, 30 held-out authors

matched_subset.rule: authors whose own-vector episode NLL lies inside the random arms' 5-95% range [2.23, 2.75]

P4.verdict: hit: perplexity NOT matched (own-vector drafts have lower NLL than random-vector drafts, a sign of repetitive text in some drafts); read the matched-subset value beside it

P5.metric: Spearman rho, vote rating vs LUAR position
P5.status: not scored: the phase-1 arena is a mock with no votes; carried to arena phase 2

P6.metric: style-note gain vs samples gain (vs k0)
P6.threshold: note gain < half the samples gain

P7.metric: base - instruct strict position at k8, mean over families
